title: Safer TCS smart finding for real FAT relay testing
titleId: Smart finding TCS yang lebih aman untuk FAT relay nyata
summary: ARSAS 1.6.23 fixes the FAT smart-finding regression that could mark valid TCS points as missing when customer IO rows contain only pathless object leaves such as .TCS1Fail or .TCS2Fail. The recovery remains conservative: exact object identity is required, near names are rejected and duplicate leaves remain ambiguous.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.23 memperbaiki regresi smart finding FAT yang dapat menandai point TCS valid sebagai missing ketika row IO customer hanya berisi object leaf tanpa path seperti .TCS1Fail atau .TCS2Fail. Recovery tetap konservatif: identitas object harus exact, nama yang hanya mirip ditolak dan duplicate leaf tetap ambiguous.
highlights: Pathless imported TCS leaves such as .TCS1Fail and .TCS2Fail can now resolve to a unique full IEC 61850 MMS object such as ADDGGIO2.TCS1Fail.stVal.
The fallback is lower priority than exact and canonical IEC 61850 matching and never uses fuzzy or Levenshtein similarity.
A duplicate object leaf present in more than one logical node remains ambiguous and automatic FAT binding is withheld.
Near-name objects such as TCS11Fail or TCS1Healthy remain missing instead of being guessed.
The fix is covered in both FAT signal selection and live-binding regression tests so the signal cannot pass preflight and then disappear when monitoring starts.
highlightsId: Imported TCS leaf tanpa path seperti .TCS1Fail dan .TCS2Fail kini dapat resolve ke satu full IEC 61850 MMS object yang unik seperti ADDGGIO2.TCS1Fail.stVal.
Fallback ini memiliki prioritas lebih rendah daripada exact dan canonical IEC 61850 matching serta tidak pernah memakai fuzzy atau Levenshtein similarity.
Duplicate object leaf yang muncul pada lebih dari satu logical node tetap ambiguous dan automatic FAT binding ditahan.
Object dengan nama yang hanya mirip seperti TCS11Fail atau TCS1Healthy tetap missing dan tidak ditebak.
Fix dilindungi regression test pada FAT signal selection dan live binding sehingga signal tidak bisa lolos preflight lalu hilang ketika monitoring dimulai.
improvements: FAT smart matching now includes a bounded exact object-leaf recovery score below exact, canonical and safe implicit-leaf matches.
Functional-constraint filtering remains active in the selection and live-binding layers.
The v1.6.23 release source passed full application regression testing, portable single-EXE smoke testing and silent installer install/uninstall testing before publication.
Release assets include SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOM, provenance metadata and GitHub artifact attestations.
improvementsId: FAT smart matching kini memiliki bounded exact object-leaf recovery score di bawah exact, canonical dan safe implicit-leaf match.
Functional-constraint filtering tetap aktif pada layer selection dan live binding.
Source release v1.6.23 lulus full application regression test, portable single-EXE smoke test dan silent installer install/uninstall test sebelum dipublikasikan.
Asset release mencakup checksum SHA-256, SPDX SBOM, metadata provenance dan GitHub artifact attestation.
knownLimitations: Physical relay validation is still required to confirm the affected TCS rows against the actual IED model used at the FAT bench.
If the same pathless object leaf exists in multiple logical nodes, ARSAS intentionally blocks automatic binding and requires a more attributable reference.
File Service FAT PASS proves successful IEC 61850 FileDirectory discovery of a supported remote fault record; it does not claim FileOpen, FileRead or FileClose transfer succeeded.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in the current stable release.
The public binaries are not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Validasi relay fisik tetap diperlukan untuk memastikan row TCS yang terdampak terhadap model IED aktual yang dipakai di FAT bench.
Jika object leaf tanpa path yang sama muncul pada beberapa logical node, ARSAS secara sengaja memblokir automatic binding dan membutuhkan reference yang lebih attributable.

File Service FAT PASS membuktikan keberhasilan IEC 61850 FileDirectory discovery terhadap remote fault record yang didukung; status ini tidak mengklaim FileOpen, FileRead atau FileClose transfer berhasil.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release saat ini.
Binary publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai dan visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable EXE do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
